title: Course registration
summary: Registration on Workflow, credit limits, SEAT electives, enrolment, add/drop, whom to contact.

posts.md:
**How Course Registration Works at IITM**

Every semester, you need to register for the courses you want to take. The entire process happens through the **Workflow** portal:

workflow.iitm.ac.in/student

There are **4 main steps**:

**1. Registration (before the semester)**

- Register online through Workflow using your **LDAP login**
- You can change your course choices until the **registration deadline**
- Your **Faculty Advisor (FA)** then reviews and approves your registration

** Credit Limit**

From the **5th semester onwards**, your maximum credit limit depends on your **CGPA**:

- **CGPA 8.5+** → Maximum **75 credits**
- **CGPA 8.0–8.5** → Maximum **70 credits**
- **CGPA below 8.0** → Maximum **66 credits**

Your **Faculty Advisor can lower your credit limit, but cannot increase it**.

The credit limit applies for the **whole semester**.

So, when choosing your courses, make sure your total credits stay within the limit applicable to you.

**2. SEAT (Electives)**

**SEAT = Student Elective Allocation Tool**

SEAT is the system that **allots elective seats based on the preferences you enter during registration**.

During registration, you enter your preferences for the electives you want to take.

**Priority:**
Students with **0 P grades** get priority first, followed by students with **1 P grade**, then **2 P grades**, and so on.

- If you don't enter any elective preferences, you **won't be allotted any elective**
- SEAT results are sent to you by **email from Workflow**

**3. Enrolment (start of semester)**

For **BTech students**:

- If you've **paid your fees**, you are enrolled automatically once your attendance is marked on **Digii**
- There is **nothing you need to do manually** for enrolment

**4. Add/Drop (first few weeks)**

If you want to change your courses after the semester starts, Add/Drop is done through the **same Workflow portal**.

- **BTech/BS/DD students** get the first couple of days before everyone else
- The **Add window closes first**
- The **Drop window opens a bit later**
- The **drop deadline is never extended**
- Your **credit limit still applies** when adding courses
- Workflow can become very slow during Add/Drop week, so **don't wait until the last day**
**Questions?**

**Course-related queries:**
helpdeskcourses@iitm.ac.in **only**

**Technical registration issues:**
Raise a Workflow ticket under **"Course Registration"**

or contact:
helpdeskworkflow@iitm.ac.in
